mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at 64 degrees with overcast skies at Harriet Park.

In city news, please be advised that Hwy M will be closed from October 6 through October 9 for road improvements, with detours directed to Old PB and East Verona Avenue. Also, remember that early in-person voting for the November 3 election begins at City Hall on October 20.

There is plenty to do in our community today, including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park and Wednesday Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, you can check out the Art Bar Happy Hour tomorrow.
Looking at the weekly report, on September 21, officers identified and cited a person for retail theft after they took candy from a retailer on East Verona Avenue.
Today's flavor of the day is a delicious Double Strawberry. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so head over to enjoy a scoop once they are open.
